concerns.text: T011 consolidates 'phrasing-check flags' into results/analysis_results.json (limitations.contains_associational must be true), but the phrasing checks are only produced in T012, which renders paper/report.md and runs the automated phrasing check. T011 is a consumer of T012's output yet is ordered before it — a consumer-before-producer violation. Either move the phrasing-check computation into T011 (checking the limitations text it consolidates) or reorder T012 before T011.

T011 must emit sensitivity_analysis entries with power_at_alpha (per the contract), but the only power computation (T010) is a single a-priori N calculation, not per-α power. Within ordering scope: T011 consumes a value no earlier task produces; add the per-α power computation to T009/T010 or note the source task explicitly.
